title: Milton Cunha Shines at Rock in Rio 2026
seoTitle: Milton Cunha Shines at Rock in Rio 2026
subtitle: The Carnival Designer and Commentator Finds Success Among Heavy Metal Fans
excerpt: Milton Cunha, 64, made an appearance on the second night of Rock in Rio 2026, blending humor, style, and passion for the festival.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Milton Cunha, 64, made his presence felt on the second night of Rock in Rio 2026, alongside his husband Vítor Moraes. The duo drew attention as they entered the stage, where the commentator wore a blue suit, a matching necklace, and a white t-shirt, while Vítor opted for an urban all-black look.

Passinho Conquers the City of Rock

For dancers, the presence of passinho at the festival solidifies the dance as art and culture. The choreography, which blends funk and rock influences, crossed the boundaries of the funk party and reached the City of Rock, showing that "rock attitude" can be found in different styles.

Irreverence and Humor On Stage

Milton stood in front of the audience, playing with his tone of voice and commenting on the lineup of bands like Sepultura, Black Pantera, and Bad Omens. He admitted that the sound of the acts "is far from his everyday style" and stated: "I steer clear of metal! If I lived with this music, I'd die, no chance!"

Vibrant Style Against Dominant Black

The carnival designer emphasized his loyalty to vibrant colors and glitter, characteristics of his identity in Carnival. He stated that metalheads "don't like black" and that he would prefer "prints, prints, and prints."

The Audience and Festival Workers

Professionals work in the City of Rock to ensure the event runs smoothly, reinforcing the importance of enjoying the shows with courtesy and care for the environment. The audience, in turn, celebrates the mix of genres, where funk meets rock and samba converses with pop.

Conclusion on Milton Cunha's Presence

Milton Cunha's presence at Rock in Rio 2026 demonstrates that the festival embraces different cultural manifestations, allowing artists from all areas to stand out and share the experience with the audience.

With information from G1, CARAS Brasil.
